source.title: Aeonas the Vindicated
source.description:
Thank you for saving me, <class>. It seems that I'm not as young as I once was, and I think I'm going to need allies for what is to come. Please, meet me in Stormwind in the Cathedral of Light as soon as you are able.

Don't worry about me, I can find my way out of here on my own. I just need a few moments to recover my strength
source.objective: Meet Aeonas at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
source.completion:
I can't thank you enough for rescuing me from that light-forsaken place. Sadly, I fear that this is just the beginning of our journey, and the rest won't be easy. Let us speak and plan our next steps.

Oh, but first... allow this old man to pass on some of his knowledge to the younger generation. It's not much of a reward, but I hope you can put it to good use none the less.
